gaps: The empty pricing-sheet activation is not covered because one setup creates only one fresh record and no operation can reset or create a second fresh record within the same plan.

the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is live.
